title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Advising Unrepresented Persons
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: An unrepresented defendant contacts the plaintiff's paralegal and asks, "Do you think I have a good defense based on these emails?" What is the only ethical response?
options: Tell them their defense is terrible so they will settle immediately.
Refuse to provide legal advice, make it clear you represent the plaintiff, and suggest they seek their own independent legal representation.
Review the emails and give an objective, neutral opinion.
Transfer their call to a duty counsel lawyer automatically.
questions.explain: Rule 4.05 requires that when dealing with an unrepresented person, the paralegal must not provide legal advice, must take care that the person is not under the illusion their interests are protected, and must urge them to get independent legal representation.
